title: Tech Note: Using ORDA with Form Data and Subforms
author: Erick Lui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The ORDA-plus-Form-object pattern for parent/subform data flow is still the current, recommended approach in 4D and remains accurate. The note itself already documents that OBJECT SET SUBFORM became unnecessary starting v17R6, so readers should apply that later-version simplification rather than the workaround shown for pre-R6 versions.
related_updates: OBJECT SET SUBFORM is no longer required since v17R6, as noted within the tech note itself — modern versions auto-update the listbox reference
The object-oriented, ORDA-based form data model described remains 4D's current, actively recommended UI architecture
